import.title: Import / Export
import.subtitle: Bring links in from browsers, JSON backups, your Docker host, or existing Nginx sites
import.browserBookmarksDesc: Import a Netscape Bookmark HTML file. Parse, preview, and de-duplicate before adding to your links.
import.jsonImportExportDesc: Export your entire site as JSON and import from a compatible backup (OneNav format supported).
import.dockerScanDesc: Auto-discover services running on your NAS by scanning your Docker host (requires hostAddress in settings).
import.nginxScanDesc: Scan your Nginx config directory and import existing server blocks as links (requires nginx:confPath in settings).
import.configNote: Configure your NAS host address and Nginx config path in
import.configNoteSuffix: so the Docker and Nginx scanners can reach your host.
